data.name: Legal.PrivacyIntro
data.value: At PRJ Proje Makina, we take the security of the personal data you share through our website seriously. This notice explains how we process your data as data controller under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and, where applicable, the GDPR. The data controller is PRJ Proje Makina A.Ş. (Mehmet Akif Ersoy Mah. Candaner Sok. No:15-A Taşoluk, 34281 Arnavutköy / Istanbul; info@prestijteknikmakine.com.tr).

data.name: Legal.Privacy1Text
data.value: Through our contact and quote forms we process your name, company, e-mail address, phone number, message content, any technical files you upload and, for security purposes, your IP address. If you consent to cookies, statistics on how the website is used are processed through Google Analytics; see the Cookie Policy for details.

data.name: Legal.Privacy3Text

data.name: Legal.Privacy4Text

data.name: Legal.Privacy5Text
